title: Gryneion (Darphane)
fact_description: Famous for its Temple of Apollo, this city is located near the Aliağa district of modern Izmir.

title: Kyme (Darphane)
fact_description: Located near the Aliağa district of Izmir, Kyme was the largest and most important harbor city of mainland Aeolis.

title: Larissa (Phrikonis) (Darphane)
fact_description: An Aeolian city situated in the Buruncuk area near the Menemen district of present-day Izmir.

title: Myrina (Darphane)
fact_description: Within the boundaries of Izmir's Aliağa district, this was another significant harbor city neighboring Kyme.

title: Mytilene (Midilli) (Darphane)
fact_description: The capital of Lesbos (Midilli), the most powerful city of Aeolis's island wing, it was one of the centers of ancient lyric poetry, home to poets like Sappho.

title: Pitane (Darphane)
fact_description: Established at the site of present-day Çandarlı, a town in the Dikili district of Izmir.

title: Herakleia Pontika (Heraclea Pontica) (Darphane)
fact_description: An important Black Sea harbor city, Herakleia corresponds to the Karadeniz Ereğli district of modern Zonguldak.

title: Kalkedon (Chalcedon) (Darphane)
fact_description: Located directly across from Istanbul, this ancient harbor city stood at the site of present-day Kadıköy district in Istanbul.

title: Nikaia (Nicaea) (Darphane)
fact_description: This city, where the historically critical First Council of Nicaea convened in Christian history, is the modern İznik district of Bursa.

title: Nikomedia (Nicomedia) (Darphane)
fact_description: The capital of the Kingdom of Bithynia and one of the four most important capitals of the Roman Empire, Nikomedia is the İzmit district of modern Kocaeli.

title: Prusa (Prusa ad Olympum) (Darphane)
fact_description: Established at the foothills of Mount Uludağ (ancient Olympos), this city is modern Bursa and served as one of the first capitals of the Ottoman Empire.

title: Caesarea (Kayseri) (Darphane)
fact_description: The capital of the Kingdom of Cappadocia and later the Roman province, Caesarea (formerly Mazaka) was the region's largest and most important minting center.

title: Tyana (Darphane)
fact_description: An important center and mint during the Roman period, Tyana is located at Kemerhisar in modern Niğde province.

title: Aphrodisias (Darphane)
fact_description: Famous for its sculpture school and well-preserved monuments, this city is located near the Karacasu district of Aydın.

title: Halikarnassos (Halikarnas) (Darphane)
fact_description: Home to one of the Seven Wonders of the World, the Mausoleum, this famous city is modern Bodrum in Muğla province, now a popular tourist destination.

title: Knidos (Darphane)
fact_description: Known for its significance in science, art, and architecture, this harbor city is located at the tip of the Datça peninsula in Muğla.

title: Mylasa (Darphane)
fact_description: One of the ancient capitals of Caria, Mylasa is the modern Milas district of Muğla.

title: Stratonikeia (Darphane)
fact_description: Also known as the city of gladiators and one of the world's largest marble cities, Stratonikeia is located within the boundaries of Yatağan district in Muğla.

title: Anazarbos (Anavarza) (Darphane)
fact_description: One of the most important cities of Cilicia Pedias, Anazarbos is located near the Kozan district of modern Adana.

title: Kilikya Pedias (Ovalık Kilikya) (Darphane)
fact_description: The eastern region watered by the Seyhan and Ceyhan rivers, comprising the fertile Çukurova plain. These rich lands and strategic harbors made the region an important trade and coin minting center throughout history.

title: Mopsos (Misis) (Darphane)
fact_description: This ancient city on the Ceyhan River (ancient Pyramos) is located near Adana and is known for the Misis Mosaic Museum.

title: Pompeiopolis (Darphane)
fact_description: Refounded by Pompey the Great, this important harbor city is located at Viranşehir in the Mezitli district of modern Mersin.

title: Seleukeia ad Kalykadnos (Silifke) (Darphane)
fact_description: Founded on the banks of the Göksu River (ancient Kalykadnos), this city is the modern Silifke district of Mersin.

title: Tarsus (Darphane)
fact_description: Known as the birthplace of Saint Paul and an important metropolis since ancient times, Tarsus is now the Tarsus district of Mersin.

title: Ankyra (Ancyra) (Darphane)
fact_description: The capital of Galatia during the Roman period, Ankyra is modern Ankara, the capital of Turkey. It is famous for the Temple of Augustus (Monumentum Ancyranum).

title: Pessinus (Darphane)
fact_description: One of the important centers of the cult of Cybele, the mother goddess, Pessinus is located near the Sivrihisar district of Eskişehir.

title: Tavion (Tavium) (Darphane)
fact_description: The center of the Trocmi, one of the Galatian tribes, Tavion is located within the boundaries of modern Yozgat province.

title: Ephesos (Efes) (Darphane)
fact_description: Located within the boundaries of Selçuk district in Izmir, famous for the Temple of Artemis, this was one of the most important metropolises of the ancient world.

title: Klazomenai (Darphane)
fact_description: Another important Ionian city located near the Urla district of modern Izmir.

title: Miletos (Milet) (Darphane)
fact_description: Homeland of philosophers like Thales, this important harbor city is located near the Didim district of modern Aydın.

title: Phokaia (Foça) (Darphane)
fact_description: Known for their mastery of seafaring, this city was established at the site of present-day Foça, a resort town in Izmir.

title: Smyrna (Darphane)
fact_description: The ancient city that forms the foundation of modern Izmir. It was an important minting center during the Roman period.

title: Teos (Darphane)
fact_description: Known for its artists and especially the cult of Dionysus, this ancient city is within the boundaries of Seferihisar district in Izmir.

title: Myra (Darphane)
fact_description: Famous for its rock-cut tombs and where Saint Nicholas (Santa Claus) served as bishop, this city is the modern Demre district of Antalya.

title: Olympos (Darphane)
fact_description: Known for its eternal flame (Chimera), this harbor city is located near the Kemer district of modern Antalya.

title: Patara (Darphane)
fact_description: Home to the parliament building of the Lycian League, this major harbor city is also located near Kaş in Antalya.

title: Tlos (Darphane)
fact_description: Believed to be where Bellerophon, owner of the winged horse Pegasus, lived, this city built on a steep hill is within the boundaries of Fethiye district in Muğla.

title: Xanthos (Ksanthos) (Darphane)
fact_description: The capital of the Lycian League, this important city is today located at Kınık neighborhood near the Kaş district of Antalya.

title: Sardes (Sardis) (Darphane)
fact_description: The capital of Lydia and its most important minting center, Sardes is located near Salihli district of modern Manisa. It is accepted that the first coins in history were minted here.

title: Adramytteion (Darphane)
fact_description: This ancient harbor city that gave its name to the Gulf of Edremit was located in the Edremit/Burhaniye area of modern Balıkesir.

title: Kyzikos (Cyzicus) (Darphane)
fact_description: One of the wealthiest cities of antiquity, known for its electrum (gold-silver alloy) coins, Kyzikos is located on the Kapıdağ Peninsula near Erdek district in Balıkesir.

title: Lampsakos (Lampsacus) (Darphane)
fact_description: Strategically positioned on the coast of the Dardanelles (Hellespont), this city gave its name to the modern Lapseki district of Çanakkale.

title: Pergamon (Bergama) (Darphane)
fact_description: Capital of the Hellenistic Kingdom of Pergamon and famous for the invention of parchment, this great city is located in the Bergama district of modern Izmir.

title: Aspendos (Darphane)
fact_description: Known for its best-preserved ancient theater, Aspendos is within the boundaries of modern Serik district in Antalya.

title: Attaleia (Darphane)
fact_description: Founded by King Attalos II of Pergamon, Attaleia is the ancient heart of modern Antalya city and was an important Pamphylian city.

title: Perge (Darphane)
fact_description: Located just beside Antalya in the modern Aksu district, this was one of the most important cities of the province.

title: Side (Darphane)
fact_description: A popular tourist destination today, Side was also one of the most important harbor and minting centers in ancient times.

title: Apameia Kibotos (Darphane)
fact_description: One of the most prolific minting centers during the Hellenistic and Roman periods, Apameia is the modern Dinar district of Afyonkarahisar.

title: Gordion (Darphane)
fact_description: Capital of the legendary Phrygian King Midas, Gordion is located near the Polatlı district of modern Ankara.

title: Kotiaeion (Cotiaeum) (Darphane)
fact_description: The ancient city of Kotiaeion was founded at the site of present-day Kütahya city.

title: Laodikeia (Laodicea on the Lycus) (Darphane)
fact_description: Famous for its textile products, this wealthy city is located near the modern Denizli province.

title: Antiocheia (Pisidya Antiocheia'sı) (Darphane)
fact_description: This major city that served as capital of the Pisidian province during the Roman period is modern Yalvaç district in Isparta.

title: Kibyra (Darphane)
fact_description: Famous for its gladiators, this ancient city is located near the Gölhisar district of modern Burdur.

title: Kremna (Cremna) (Darphane)
fact_description: A Roman colony built on an impressive hilltop in the Bucak district of Burdur, serving as an important minting center.

title: Sagalassos (Darphane)
fact_description: Mentioned in your project plans, Sagalassos is within the boundaries of Ağlasun district in modern Burdur. It is one of the most important and best-preserved ancient cities of the region.

title: Selge (Darphane)
fact_description: An important mountain city located on the southern slopes of the Taurus Mountains, within the boundaries of Manavgat district in Antalya.

title: Termessos (Darphane)
fact_description: Located in Güllük Dağı National Park northwest of Antalya, this city is known for its pristine nature and well-preserved structures.

title: Amaseia (Amasya) (Darphane)
fact_description: The first capital of the Kingdom of Pontus, located in the Yeşilırmak (ancient Iris) valley, this is modern Amasya city.

title: Amisos (Samsun) (Darphane)
fact_description: Forming the foundation of modern Samsun city, this was another major harbor city that played a key role in Black Sea trade and served as a royal mint.

title: Kabeira (Neokaisareia) (Darphane)
fact_description: An important fortress and mint of Mithridates VI, this is the modern Niksar district of Tokat province.

title: Kerasos (Giresun) (Darphane)
fact_description: Founded at the site of modern Giresun city, this ancient harbor city is known as the place from which cherries spread to the world.

title: Sinope (Sinop) (Darphane)
fact_description: Possessing one of the most important natural harbors of the Black Sea, this strategic Greek colony later became the capital of the Kingdom of Pontus and is modern Sinop city.

title: Trapezus (Trabzon) (Darphane)
fact_description: One of the easternmost important Greek colonies of the region, serving as one of the Black Sea gateways of the Silk Road, this is modern Trabzon city.

title: Abydos (Darphane)
fact_description: Located at the narrowest point of the Dardanelles Strait, this ancient city at the key crossing point from Asia to Europe is near Nara Burnu, close to modern Çanakkale center.

title: Alexandria Troas (Darphane)
fact_description: Founded by Alexander the Great's generals and considered in the Roman period as a potential "New Rome," this massive harbor city is located near the Ezine district of modern Çanakkale.

title: Assos (Darphane)
fact_description: Famous for its Temple of Athena and where philosopher Aristotle lived for a time, this harbor city is located at Behramkale village in the Ayvacık district of Çanakkale.

title: Sigeion (Yeniköy) (Darphane)
fact_description: Located at the Aegean entrance of the Dardanelles, where Achilles's tomb is believed to be, this ancient city is near Yeniköy connected to modern Çanakkale center.

title: Tenedos (Bozcaada) (Darphane)
fact_description: Located directly across from Troy, playing a strategic role in the Iliad and minting its own coins, this is modern Bozcaada island.

title: Troia (Ilium / Truva) (Darphane)
fact_description: Center of the legendary war and consisting of nine layers, this ancient city is located at Hisarlık Hill connected to modern Çanakkale city center.
